source: GET https://api.trustedrouter.com/attestation?nonce=<32 random bytes hex>, with the TLS leaf read from the same connection
google_signature: verified against Google's live JWKS at capture

eat_nonce.0: SHA-256 of the served TLS leaf certificate (live-gateway-leaf.pem); the token has no tls_cert_sha256 claim
eat_nonce.1: gateway commitment not interpreted by this SDK (identical across instances)
eat_nonce.2: gateway commitment not interpreted by this SDK (differs per connection)
eat_nonce.3: the caller nonce from the request

note: Claims are re-signed with a test key and given a fresh exp by the tests; the Google signature is not part of the fixture.
